Taylor M.: heads-up: noticed a steady trickle of leads that get enriched but then bounce between HS and our RR router for ~10-25m. customers slipping through handoff SLA.
Rae (SDR): saw a few in my queue today - one was enriched at 9:05 but I didn't get assigned until 9:28. leads show multiple assign attempts in the timeline.
Zoe: preliminary trace -> enrichment webhook sometimes returns 202 then final 200. HS sets `enriched=true` on 202 which triggers RR. RR tries claim, enrichment completes with final payload, HS sends another assign event, duplicate attempts happen.
Lee (ops): root idea: only mark leads as routable when `enrichment_status == complete`. for intermediate 202 responses set `enrichment_pending=true` and delay routing. can we change HS workflow?
Taylor M.: yes. two changes: 1) HS: set `enrichment_status = pending|complete|failed`; only route on `complete`. 2) RR: ignore leads with `enrichment_status==pending` and add an `enrichment_finalized` webhook that unblocks routing.
Rae (SDR): will that add visible delay? we want faster handoffs when enrichment is actually done.
Zoe: shouldn't add delay for normal fast paths. this only affects cases where vendor returns interim 202. normal 200 -> enriched complete -> immediate route. also add metric `enrichment_interim_rate` so we can alert on vendor flapping.
Lee (ops): short-term mitigation: add a 30s debounce in RR for enriched events per-lead. if a second enrichment event arrives within 30s, coalesce. avoids immediate duplicate claims.
Taylor M.: agree on debounce + status. longer-term: add idempotency key on assign events: `assign_id = sha256(lead_id + enrichment_version)` so retries are no-ops.
Rae (SDR): nice. small UX ask: if a lead was held for enrichment_finalization, show timeline note "Held pending final enrichment - routed at <time>" so SDRs aren't confused.
automation-bot: Alert rule created: if enrichment_interim_rate > 1% for 15m -> #marketing (rule id: RB-9991).
Zoe: plan: PR for HS workflow change today, router debounce behind flag. canary on 5% traffic for 1h. watch metrics: time_to_first_assignment_p95, duplicate_claims_rate, enrichment_interim_rate.
Lee (ops): will add logs for easy triage e.g.:
[2026-07-12T09:05:12Z] lead=L-443 enrichment_status=pending event=webhook_202
[2026-07-12T09:05:42Z] lead=L-443 enrichment_status=complete event=webhook_200 routed=true
Taylor M.: ok team, let's run the canary this afternoon. Zoe, ping when PR is up. Rae, we'll add the timeline copy to SDR runbook. Thanks. :thumbsup:
